rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that cannot be avoided or prevented.

example.english: This problem is inevitable, so we have to face it.
example.traditional: 呢個問題無可避免，要正面面對。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 mou4 ho2 bei6 min5 jiu3 zing3 min6 min6 deoi3

rows.note: Use this when the result is predictable or expected, rather than stressing that it cannot be prevented.

example.english: Once things had reached this stage, the outcome was inevitable.
example.traditional: 事情發展到呢一步，結果係意料之中。
example.jyutping: si6 cing4 faat3 zin2 dou3 ni1 jat1 bou6 git3 gwo2 hai6 ji3 liu6 zi1 zung1
